title: AIV audit report
description: The output shape of an AIV audit. Implementations that emit this can be compared with each other.

rubric_version.description: A score without this is not comparable to anything.

audited_at.description: Engine behaviour moves; a score is a point-in-time reading.

audience_language.description: BCP-47. Determines whether the non-English engine check applies.

sampled_urls.description: Every URL the audit read. Without these the score cannot be reproduced.

points.description: Required when state is scored or failed; absent otherwise

evidence.description: What was observed. Required for failed and unobservable — an audit that hides its reasoning is worth less than a lower score

reason.description: Why a check is unobservable or not_applicable

score.description: Sum of points across scored and failed checks

observable_max.description: 100 minus the points of unobservable and not_applicable checks

normalised.description: round(score / observable_max * 100). The band is read from this, not from score

excluded.description: Checks removed from the denominator, with their point value and reason. Two scores are comparable only when their observable_max match.
